serverInfo.name: dead-mans-snitch-mcp
serverInfo.title: Dead Man's Snitch MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Dead Man's Snitch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my scheduled job monitors are failing or late?"; "Show details of my nightly backup monitor."; "List my monitors tagged 'backups' and how often each should check in.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Dead Man's Snitch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run deadmanssnitch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run deadmanssnitch_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run deadmanssnitch_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. deadmanssnitch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_list_snitches
tools.title: List snitches
tools.description: List the snitches (cron/heartbeat monitors) of the account with status (pending, healthy, failed, errored, paused), interval, alert type, tags and last check-in. Tokens are masked (the token is also the check-in secret); pass the masked token or the name to the other snitch tools. The API has no paging: all snitches come back. Optionally filter by tags (must have all) or status. GET /v1/snitches.

tags.description: Only snitches that have ALL of these tags.

status.description: Only snitches in this status (filtered here).

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_get_snitch
tools.title: Get snitch
tools.description: One snitch with its full details, including the check-in URL (https://nosnch.in/<token>). The check-in URL is a secret: anyone who has it can check in and so silence the alert; share it only where the job runs. GET /v1/snitches/{token}.

snitch.description: The snitch: its token, the masked token shown by deadmanssnitch_list_snitches (e.g. ab…yz), or its exact name.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_create_snitch
tools.title: Create snitch
tools.description: WRITE: create a new snitch (monitor). Returns it with its check-in URL (https://nosnch.in/<token>), which the job must call on every run; keep it secret. Fails with 402 when the plan's snitch limit is reached. POST /v1/snitches.

interval.description: Expected check-in frequency. The *_minute values are only available on the Basic plan; weekly = Monday to Monday.

alert_email.description: Email addresses that get this snitch's alerts instead of all team members (max 10; this limit is ours, not the vendor's). An empty list clears the override.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_update_snitch
tools.title: Update snitch
tools.description: WRITE: change a snitch. Only the fields you pass change. `tags` REPLACES the whole tag list (use deadmanssnitch_add_tags to add) and `alert_email` replaces the alert recipients (an empty list = all team members). Returns the updated snitch with the token masked. PATCH /v1/snitches/{token}.

snitch.description: The snitch: its token, the masked token shown by deadmanssnitch_list_snitches (e.g. ab…yz), or its exact name.

interval.description: Expected check-in frequency. The *_minute values are only available on the Basic plan; weekly = Monday to Monday.

alert_type.description: basic = fixed deadline; smart = learns when the job usually checks in and alerts earlier.

alert_email.description: Email addresses that get this snitch's alerts instead of all team members (max 10; this limit is ours, not the vendor's). An empty list clears the override.

tags.description: The complete new tag list (replaces the old one; [] removes all tags).

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_add_tags
tools.title: Add tags
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more tags to a snitch, keeping the existing ones. Returns the snitch's full tag list. POST /v1/snitches/{token}/tags.

snitch.description: The snitch: its token, the masked token shown by deadmanssnitch_list_snitches (e.g. ab…yz), or its exact name.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_remove_tag
tools.title: Remove tag
tools.description: WRITE: remove one tag from a snitch (the snitch itself is untouched). Returns the remaining tags. DELETE /v1/snitches/{token}/tags/{tag}.

snitch.description: The snitch: its token, the masked token shown by deadmanssnitch_list_snitches (e.g. ab…yz), or its exact name.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_pause_snitch
tools.title: Pause snitch
tools.description: WRITE: pause a snitch, which SILENCES its alerts: a job that stops running goes unnoticed while it is paused. `until` says when alerting resumes: 'healthy' (default: on the next healthy check-in), 'unpaused' (stays paused until deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch) or a future ISO 8601 time. A snitch that has never checked in (pending) cannot be paused. POST /v1/snitches/{token}/pause.

snitch.description: The snitch: its token, the masked token shown by deadmanssnitch_list_snitches (e.g. ab…yz), or its exact name.

until.description: 'healthy' (default), 'unpaused', or a future ISO 8601 time with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-20T08:00:00Z.

tools.name: deadmanssnitch_unpause_snitch
tools.title: Unpause snitch
tools.description: WRITE: resume alerting for a paused snitch (safe on a snitch that is not paused). POST /v1/snitches/{token}/unpause.

snitch.description: The snitch: its token, the masked token shown by deadmanssnitch_list_snitches (e.g. ab…yz), or its exact name.
